CurrentQuirkOne: Cure Liquer: Spend 1 Bond to heal 3HP to a target.
CurrentQuirkTwo: Encouraging Aura: Spend 1 Bond to empower the Tamer's next skill roll.
InheritableQuirkOne: Blessed Guard: Tamer can use an action to debuff attacks on gaurd .
InheritableQuirkTwo: Empathy and Carry: Roll for Empathy or Carry Checks.
InheritableQuirkThree: Warrior Reflex: Spend a strat-point to use a Contact move twice.
BasicConcept: Lunges with a headbutt at the target.
BasicBonus: Stuns the target for one turn.
BasicPenalty: Bonus to attacks against user this round.
StandardConcept: Charges an energy bark while biting the target.
StandardBonus: Does 3 Damage to the Target on it's next x turns.
SpecialConcept: A distracting attempt at a war howl.
SpecialEffect: Stuns target so they can't attack this turn.
SpecialBonus: Stuns x many more opponents for this turn.
SpecialPenalty: Stuns x many allies can't move this turn.
SuperConcept: Barks to create an offensive sound wave.
SuperBonus: Nerfs target's next attack roll by x dice.
SuperPenalty: Stuns the user on their next turn
